description: The last measured liveness of free, no-key public data APIs: HTTP status and latency from one read-only GET per API, with the generated_at of that measurement. status SLOW means the API timed out at 10s and answered a 45s re-probe (works, not fast); DOWN means no answer within 45s. Note counts.measured excludes SKIP rows, which were never called — use it as the health denominator, not counts.total.

api.description: Substring match on API name; omit for all

name: check_api_health
